items.title: 20.2 Tibbi imaging mein ultrasound ka tashkheesi istemal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of diagnostic ultrasound (PDF 158-159).

blocks.text: Ultrasound doctors ko jism ki andaruni banawatein usi waqt (real time) dekhne deta hai (Fig 20.2 ultrasound machine dikhati hai). Transducer zyada frequency ki awaz ki lehrein, aam taur par 1 MHz se 15 MHz, jism mein bhejta hai. Lehrein jism se guzar kar mukhtalif tissues ki sarhadon se mun'akis hoti hain; goonj (echoes) jama kar ke tajziya karne se tasveer banti hai. Bara faida yeh hai ke ultrasound ionising shuaein use nahi karta, is liye mehfooz, ghair-dakhli aur dohraya ja sakta hai.

Piezoelectric transducer ultrasound ke pulses chhorta hai, jo mukhtalif tissues mein mukhtalif raftar se chalte hain. Jab lehar mukhtalif acoustic impedance (tissue ki density aur us mein awaz ki raftar se tay) wale do tissues ki sarhad se milti hai to us ka kuch hissa mun'akis hota hai. Phir transducer receive mode mein ja kar direct piezoelectric effect se mun'akis lehrein pakarta hai. Goonj bijli ke signals banti hai; computer har goonj ki der aur taqat se tasveer banata hai. Zyada taqatwar inikas zyada roshan nazar aate hain, jo aza aur tissues ki andaruni banawat dikhate hain. Kyunke har pulse sarhad tak ja kar wapas aata hai, sarhad ki gehrai d = vt/2 hai, jahan v awaz ki raftar (naram tissue mein taqreeban 1540 m/s) aur t goonj ka waqt hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Probe skin par rakh kar ultrasound pulses andar bhejta hai (safaid lehrein); tissues ki sarhadon se goonj (echo) wapas probe tak aati hai. Goonj ke aane ka waqt t ho to sarhad ki gehrai d = vt/2 hai, jahan naram tissue mein v taqreeban 1540 m/s hai.
Tasveer ke mayaar par asar dalne wale awamil

items: Acoustic impedance ka farq: do tissues (maslan naram tissue aur haddi) mein zyada farq zyada taqatwar goonj aur zyada saaf sarhadein deta hai.
Ultrasound ki frequency: zyada frequency behtar resolution lekin kam nufooz deti; kam frequency zyada gehrai tak jati lekin kam saaf tasveer deti hai.
Gel ka istemal: transducer aur jild ke darmiyan khaas gel hawa ke khala hata kar awaz ki lehron ki muntaqili behtar karta hai.

blocks.text: Ultrasound bohat se tibbi shobon mein use hota hai. Zachgi (obstetrics) mein yeh bachche ki nashonuma ki nigrani, hamal ki umar ka andaza aur hamal ke dauran kharabiyon ki pehchan karta hai. Pet mein yeh jigar, gurde, pitta (gallbladder), pancreas aur masane ki jaanch karta hai. Dil ke shobe mein echocardiography dil ki banawat aur kaam usi waqt dikhati hai. Urology mein yeh prostate, testicles aur peshab ke nizam ki jaanch, aur patthon aur haddiyon ke nizam mein ligament ki chot, joron ki sozish aur naram tissues ki doosri bimariyon ki pehchan mein madad deta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Ultrasound probe ke crystals chawal ke daane se chhote hote hain, lekin awaz ki lehrein bhej aur pakar dono sakte hain. Ultrasound Doppler effect se awaz ki frequency ki tabdeeli pakar kar khoon ke bahao ki raftar bhi naap sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Pulse ke 65 microsecond baad goonj wapas aati hai. Agar tissue mein awaz ki raftar 1540 m/s ho to sarhad kitni gehri hai?

items: Ultrasound (1-15 MHz) mukhtalif acoustic impedance ki sarhadon se mun'akis.
Gehrai d = vt/2; taqatwar goonj zyada roshan.
Tasveer ka mayaar: impedance ka farq, frequency (resolution ke muqable nufooz), gel.
